description.value: The qathet Museum and Archives Society — formerly the Powell River Forestry Museum — preserves and presents the history of the qathet region on BC's Sunshine Coast. Housed on Marine Avenue in Powell River, it offers archival records and exhibits documenting the area's forestry, Indigenous, and settler heritage. Touring cyclists passing through Powell River will find it a worthwhile cultural stop in a town rich with industrial and maritime history.
